'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Winston Plunkett LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: GIMME THAT DUN DUN DUN DUNNN!. Transcription note: sheet name Winston "Yellowshirt" Plunkett

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates]]
* '''Username:''' WINSTONP
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
